倣.title: imitate; emulate
倣.reason: Actual current cards inspected: 放 lacks left 亻 and names release/emission, 方 is only part of the right side and names direction/method, 付 shares 亻 but names attachment. Full target source meanings are emulate/imitate, not these three operations. A model may present a method; that relationship does not make imitation mean method itself.
倣.rejected: 写 copy/photograph and 則 rule/follow a model overlap; 似 resemble is a useful conceptual contrast but not curated as a safely wrong imitation-related answer. 倉 has no card. No absent-card distractor or phonetic/origin assertion imported.
倣.legacyFallback: Eleven existing cards have fewer than three curated distractors; actual labels checked by draft audit. None names imitation/emulation. Existing 写/似/則 already have three choices. No default-four-choice collision established; larger/random/live pools unverified.

pairDecisions.disposition: Direct imitation/emulation label and sense overlap. Noun/verb differences and model に versus object を do not make competing uncontextualized English imitation answers safe. Each edge is declared on new 模倣; existing exclusions are preserved without transitive assumptions.

Actual displayed copy/copying labels and complete families establish overlap. 写す also explicitly includes imitation/modeling after. Photocopy/document examples and other senses do not make generic copying a wrong answer for these words. Conservative direct safeguards, not unrestricted Japanese interchangeability.

Additional direct conservative written-copying/fair-copy label safeguards after reading both actual articles and complete frozen families. Broad English copying can be accepted for their copying activities; dictation and neat rewriting have more specific aims, but those distinctions are not supplied by an uncontextualized copying choice. This does not claim that 模倣 always names dictation or fair rewriting.

No new guard established: actual obey/follow/comply and resemble labels concern compliance/following or similarity without necessarily imitating. Shared English follow between 倣う and 従う does not make a transitive exclusion clique around 模倣.

lexicalDispositions.disposition: Reuse actual 倣う ならう, intransitive godan, imitate/emulate/follow an example. The whole sense is usually-kana; 傚う and 慣らう are rare spellings, not rare pronunciations. The existing N2 article correctly retains に for the model and the distinction from instructional 習う. Preserve its filename, title, reading, N2 level, tags and four original exclusions; the future component edit should only link 倣 at its substantive introduction.

One necessary new support candidate: 模倣 もほう, noun/transitive suru, imitation/copying. It directly supplies ホウ with モ for 模, independently supported by the actual character entry naming 模倣. 摸倣 is a rare spelling; there is no existing same-family article to reuse. Do not assign vocabulary N1 from this kanji. The public dictionary also recognizes historical ぼほう, but that is not the frozen family's selected もほう and does not invalidate it.

見習う みならう supports following an example or learning by observation, but 見倣う is marked rare and 見ならう search-only. No new article is needed merely to multiply examples. Do not transfer the compound's transitivity to standalone 倣う.
Complete 先例に倣う せんれいにならう and 前例に倣う ぜんれいにならう families verify the precedent construction and に. Useful short unlinked examples; no separate phrase articles required.

模倣者 もほうしゃ is an imitator; 模倣犯 もほうはん has both criminal and crime senses; 模倣品 もほうひん includes counterfeit goods/knock-off. These do not make all imitation derogatory, criminal or fraudulent. Retain family evidence without expanding the necessary support scope.
倣岸 is an irregular spelling in the 傲岸 ごうがん haughty/arrogant family. It is not evidence to add ゴウ to the frozen on-list or to teach an ordinary 倣 word with that allocation.

右へならえ/右へ倣え みぎへならえ has a military drill-command sense and a separate uncritical-following-suit sense. 右へ習え is marked irregular. This fixed expression is not an unrestricted 倣う/習う interchangeability rule and is unnecessary for the bounded draft.

Preserve complete 顰みに倣う/顰に倣う family: ひそみにならう and restricted ひんにならう for 顰に倣う only, with three search-only spellings and the sometimes-humble note. Do not turn the phrase's ridicule gloss into a universal register claim for 倣う; leave this rare-character idiom outside the practical card.

comparisonDispositions.disposition: 習う ならう is a separate transitive godan entry, taking lessons/learning from a teacher. The actual existing N5 article teaches skill を and teacher に/から. Use the existing identity for a contrast; shared pronunciation is neither an error nor permission to replace spellings indiscriminately.
真似 まね includes imitation/copying and a separate behavior/action sense. マネ is kana-only in this family. Its existing imitation label overlaps proposed 模倣 regardless of its additional behavior sense.

手本 てほん and 模範 もはん name models/examples, not the action of imitation itself. Neither has a current article; the existing 見本/典型/モデル bodies were inspected only as semantic navigation. Do not add these words or infer that a typical example is necessarily a good model.

模する/摸する もする and 模す/摸す もす are distinct special-suru/godan transitive forms. Both families include imitation/modeling and tracing/forging senses. They support 模's contribution but do not require new articles, change 模倣's noun-plus-suru conjugation or make every use of 模 a forgery.

All four exact 人 families inspected: ジン suffixes, と person suffix, ひと person/human with restricted kana spelling ヒト, and ニン counter. They contextualize the indexing radical only; none licenses a new 倣 reading or proves a historical semantic derivation from 人.

All five exact 方 families retained with respectful, suffix, comparison and archaic/poetic restrictions. 方's actual direction/method label is a possible wrong meaning for 倣, not evidence that shared ホウ makes readings or whole-word meanings interchangeable.
蔵/倉/庫 くら means storehouse/warehouse and related storage senses. This navigational look-alike candidate has no current 倉 card and therefore cannot be selected as an existing-card distractor.

quizcomparisonDispositions.disposition: コピー's copy/photocopy noun and transitive-suru sense overlaps an English copying label; separate blurb/advertising-slogan senses do not remove that overlap. Preserve its existing N5 metadata.

似る にる is an intransitive resemblance verb. Similarity need not involve copying. Its label and the 似 kanji are useful contrast evidence, but 似 should not be casually curated as an unambiguously wrong imitation-related answer without the final whole-construction review.

従う したがう covers obeying/compliance, following/accompanying, going alongside and serving/working. Preserve rare versus search-only spelling flags. Existing 倣う/従う exclusion is already direct and must remain; a blanket 模倣/従う exclusion is not established by shared English follow alone.
真似る まねる is transitive ichidan imitation/mimicry and overlaps proposed 模倣. Its existing direct exclusion with 倣う is declared on 真似る; exclusion declarations need not be duplicated.

複写 ふくしゃ, noun/transitive-suru, includes copying, duplication, reproduction and a copy. Inspecting its full actual article confirms copying overlap despite document-oriented examples. An exclusion via 真似 does not protect a new 模倣/複写 pair transitively.

写す うつす includes copying/transcribing, depicting, imitation/modeling and photography in separate senses. The explicit imitation/model-after sense matters beyond the displayed copy; photograph title. 撮す is search-only as a spelling element, with a photograph-sense note. Preserve original spelling/reading identity; the new support word must address direct overlap rather than relying on title strings.
